text:
lina: quick sync thread — need a final 20m runbook for the webinar on Thurs. working title: 'Predictable Inference: practical levers for cost, latency, and reliability'
sam: sounds good. propose we surface concrete tradeoffs: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, plus routing & fallback patterns.
ochloe: speaker plan idea: sam intro + decision flow (4m), owen architecture + live demo (10m), chloe metrics + rapid q/a (5m), lina close & CTA (1m)
owen: can demo a 2-step flow: short chat prompt -> reranker pass to improve responses. prefer to run demo on Dedicated, but can mock Hosted path for comparison. will prep a pre-warm script.
lina: please confirm whether demo uses real customer data or synthetic by EOD. also need a 30s fallback recording if live demo fails.
sam: abstract draft: "We walk engineers through an operational framework for choosing serving modes, optimizing batching and caching, and keeping per-token costs predictable — plus a live rerank demo and routing/fallback patterns." feedback?
ochloe: good. call out quantization and per-route cost visibility. i'll make a slide with median p50/p90 latency and cost per million tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated.
owen: demo fallback plan: record the rerank session and capture console trace + token breakdown. if live fails, cut to recording and narrate.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rehearsal reserved: Wed 09:00-09:30 PT in #marketing-rehearsals
lina: run-of-show (20m strict):
```
- 0:00-0:00:45 - welcome & housekeeping (lina)
- 0:00:45-0:04:30 - decision flow: when to pick Hosted/Dedicated/Private (sam)
- 0:04:30-0:14:30 - live demo: chat + rerank (owen)
- 0:14:30-0:19:30 - benchmarks & operational tips (chloe)
- 0:19:30-0:20:00 - quick Q&A + CTA & lead routing note (lina)
```
chloe: timing looks tight but doable. i'll trim slides to 3x visuals for benchmarks.
sam: i'll produce a one-slide visual decision tree. design, can you make a variant with both light and dark backgrounds? @design-team
ops-bot: :spiral_note_pad: follow-up assets checklist created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/assets/webinar-2311 
lina: rehearsal checklist: mic check, screen-share order, demo creds in a shared vault, pre-warm, fallback clip queued, backup laptop. please ACK.
chloe: ack, will bring bench numbers and the cost table.
owen: ack, will add pre-warm command and provide demo creds. pre-warm example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/instances/prewarm -d '{"model":"mini-chat","tokens":256}'`
sam: ack. i'll rehearse transitions with owen to avoid dead air.
ops-bot: :memo: audience follow-up form template created; include required field "inference_use_case" for routing.
lina: routing rules decision: high-intent leads (>=2000 tokens/mo or demo request) -> AE; everything else -> SDR. also add a checkbox for "regulated / compliance" to route to enterprise team.
chloe: i'll add those fields to the post-webinar survey and produce a CSV mapping for SDRs.
sam: note for social copy: highlight the practical checklist and the rerank demo. keep CTAs to demo request + trial credits.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: social assets deadline set: Tue 18:00 PT. design pinged.
lina: perfect. small risk: demo depends on Dedicated capacity slot. owen, can you confirm reserved instance by EOD?
owen: will confirm in 2 hours. if not secured, we'll switch demo to a recorded walkthrough and narrate differences.
lina: thanks team. we'll run the dry run Wed 09 and go live Thurs. I'll update invite with assets earlier today.
